_what: The Stim Tin, in the Regulation Nook of Helen Edgar's Faery Yurt: her ask of 2026-10-28, named by her, with a film. tools/make-yurt-stim.py writes it into faery-yurt.html between yurt-stim markers. Each line about how a toy feels is ours, written for her nook; none says what a toy does for anybody.
intro: My stim tin: things to fidget and stim with, and what each one feels like in the hand.

toys.name: A bit of everything
toys.feel: Stringy, twisty, spiky, soft, and something to watch: a whole board to pick from.
toys.shows: A board of fidget toys painted in soft colours: a purple stringy ball, a teal spiky ball, a pink-orange wand, a yellow puzzle cube, a blue-green brush and a blue ball.

toys.name: A fidget spinner
toys.feel: Spins and spins, with a hum you can feel in your fingers.
toys.shows: A red fidget spinner with three rounded arms, painted in watercolour on cream paper.

toys.name: A fidget cube
toys.feel: A click, a switch, a dial: something different on every side.
toys.shows: A cream fidget cube with yellow buttons, a switch and a dial, painted in watercolour.

toys.name: A pop-it
toys.feel: Rows of bubbles to press with a soft pop, then turn it over and pop them all again.
toys.shows: A sea-green pop-it with three rows of bubbles, pink, yellow and lilac, painted in watercolour.

toys.name: Squishes
toys.feel: Squeeze, and let go slowly, and squeeze again.
toys.shows: Three squeezy toys painted in watercolour: a blue cube, a yellow star and a green ball.

toys.name: A slinky
toys.feel: Pours from one hand to the other with a soft shush.
toys.shows: A rainbow slinky standing in an arch, painted in watercolour.

toys.name: A crochet square
toys.feel: Soft wool, with a ball inside to chase about with your thumb.
toys.shows: A pale yellow crochet square with blue stitches and the shape of a ball inside it, painted in watercolour.

toys.name: A going-out bag
toys.feel: Quiet for the ears, words on a card, and something for the hands.
toys.shows: A going-out bag's things painted in watercolour: teal ear defenders, a yellow lanyard and a white card.

videos.title: In Motion - Subtitled
videos.about: In Motion, a short film by Sophie Broadgate, with subtitles.

_drawings: Since 2026-11-09, at Helen's ask, every toy is a drawing and not a photograph: painted in code by Claude in a soft watercolour look on cream paper (her choice from three tries that day: rounder and whole, less watery), the drawings themselves held in make-yurt-stim.py under the key each toy names in `draw`, the way the murals' are. The photographs they replaced (eight off Wikimedia Commons, by MissLunaRose12, Árni Dagur, Tetizeraz, Ric Aries, Stephen Edmonds, Fitrah 9131, Valki77 and Bruxton) came out with their credits. `shows` is what each drawing shows, read out as the picture's words.
